title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Ask before you tell
hook: After a mistake, do you explain or ask first?
intro: You already know what they should have done.
statement: Kids remember what they figure out.
q1: Do you ask what they saw before you correct —
q2: or give the answer and keep practice moving?
q3: How much time can one question cost?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But lessons stick
t2: when the player finds part of the answer.
cta: Coaches — do you ask or tell?
ctaLines: What did you see? Where was the space?
One question first, or the answer right away?
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
After a mistake, do you explain or ask first?
You already know what they should have done.
Kids remember what they figure out.
Ask first or tell first. There is no single right way.
Do you ask or tell? Share your habit in the comments.
